gaps: P0: no candidates; P2: only crude copies of Merian’s view (#7–#9); P4 has only one strong 1890s view
notes: Merian #2 preferred over the color Braun and Hogenberg strip #3 (small, very narrow); #5 has the gutter through Worms and Speyer, #4 is tiny. #7–#9 (Les Forces de l’Europe, 1693–1726) are coarse reworkings of Merian’s plate with the great wine barrel added; #9 (1693–96) could fill P2 if wanted (trim about [0.128, 0.168, 0.693, 0.82]). #15 (castle from the Hirschgasse) is an alternative photochrom. #28 is a little hazy and the castle is not in view; #25 is a posterized black-and-white panorama, #27 is Heidelberg West in Australia.
